sentence: This project studies whether children who had otitis media still have long-lasting listening problems after the pathology has resolved.
This project makes and studies human neurons grown from induced pluripotent stem cells to learn how gene variants relate to neurodevelopmental disorders.
This project screens microbial extracts to find natural products that target a methyl transferase in bacteria and could serve as leads for antibiotics.
This project builds high-speed 3D tracking methods to follow single viruses such as influenza as they move through the epithelial space.
This project develops methods to visualize and automatically outline thalamic nuclei that are hard to see in conventional MRI.
This project studies how transcription and DNA replication collide on genomic DNA and how helicases that unwind DNA compensate for one another.
This project studies how ferroptosis works and how it connects with signaling events inside and between cancer cells.
This project builds a multimodal imaging platform to track tumor cells and immune cells in glioblastoma and understand two therapies for it.
This project studies how stress reactivity, in addition to stress exposure, relates to adverse pregnancy outcomes.
This project uses fruitfly Drosophila and neurons made from patient stem cells to find molecular pathways involved in frontotemporal dementia.
This project studies whether old drugs can be reused to target multiple pathological processes in Alzheimer's disease.
This project uses patient specimens to study what plasma cells in cardiac allograft vasculopathy do and how they contribute to the rejection process.
This project develops a deep learning photoacoustic histology platform that makes images to help pathologists and surgeons diagnose tumors during surgery.
This project studies whether a synthetic progestin can prevent preterm labor and intrauterine inflammation in Rhesus macaques.
This project studies how an epigenetic process controls the way cells change from one state to another during lung alveoli repair and regeneration.
This project investigates whether large language models can detect language changes that mark early Alzheimer's disease in a fair and responsible way.
This project studies how bariatric surgery affects oral health by combining registry data of surgery patients with a population database.
This project studies social and communicative behavior and brain activity in autistic people who also have intellectual disability.
This project studies the molecular mechanism of a form of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease found in a mouse forward genetic screen.
This project follows medicinal cannabis patients to learn how tolerance and withdrawal relate to addiction and what raises the risk of cannabis use disorder.
